requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed bottles supporting 6,000-page yield for black and CMY, with CMY bottle size >8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Increases ink capacity and reduces customer intervention, aligning with competitive CISS offerings.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires new bottle design and compatibility with existing system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles must deliver specified page yields in standard ISO tests; must be keyed to prevent incorrect insertion.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure the new NGB bottles provide spill-free operation during installation and use.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user experience and reduces service costs related to ink spills.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spill observed in 100% of installation tests under normal conditions.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F component with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label for improved performance.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and traceability of the NOA-F component.
requirements.Dependencies: Design integration with NOA-F and labeling process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All NOA-F units include metal foiled labyrinth and lid label as verified in quality audits.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Enable end customers to replace PHA and NOA-F components themselves.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service costs and downtime for customers, improving satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Component design for tool-less replacement and user instructions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customers can replace PHA and NOA-F without tools within 5 minutes following provided instructions.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: Set and support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances product value and aligns with new competitive benchmarks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device must operate without major failure for 80,000 pages under standard usage conditions.

requirements.Title: Product ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Increase the tank size for the Reddington ID product variant, ensuring no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher ink capacity and longer use between refills.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank size increased as per specifications; no interference with ADF operation.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the PDL SKU meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Mandatory for market access and sustainability goals.
requirements.Dependencies: Design and materials selection, certification process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes all required certifications prior to launch.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Redesign for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to accommodate the increased tank protrusion due to larger ink tanks.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical compatibility and user convenience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function correctly with new tank dimensions; verified in assembly and user testing.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3” CGD display into the product for improved user interface.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances usability and aligns with modern user expectations.
requirements.Dependencies: Electrical and mechanical integration, UI software.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Display operates with full functionality; passes usability and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management with Spit Platform Changes
requirements.Description: Implement aerosol management in the service station to handle changes due to increased tank size and spit platform updates.
requirements.Rationale: Maintains print quality and prevents contamination inside the printer.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station and spit platform design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No aerosol-related print defects or contamination after 80,000 pages of operation.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update the carriage dynamic and force model to account for new tube routing and increased weights from larger tanks.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical reliability and print quality with new hardware configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube design, tank and carriage integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates reliably under all tested conditions; no increased wear or failure.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Enhancement for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Modify paper path components to support increased warranty page life (80,000 pages).
requirements.Rationale: Reduces maintenance and supports higher warranty targets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components show no excessive wear after 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as a Serviceable Part Post-80K Life
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance components to be serviceable at a service center after 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Extends printer life and supports service business model.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service center can replace/maintain ink components after 80,000 pages within 30 minutes.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement a new make-break and fluidic interface (FI) connection for the IDS system, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and compatibility with new ink system.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS, LEBI tank design, SHAID integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System passes all connection integrity and leak tests in production units.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new IDS startup algorithm and air management system to support the new ink system.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable startup and prevents air-related print defects.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup passes 100% of reliability tests; no air-related failures reported in field trials.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Establish new print quality (PQ) goals and ink depletion metrics to align with new page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product meets customer expectations and yield claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality and depletion metrics meet or exceed defined targets in validation tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Continue use of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in the new product.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development costs and leverages proven components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No issues found in integration and reliability tests with reused components.

requirements.Title: Integration of Stingray Wi-Fi Module and Dune Firmware
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module and Dune firmware for wireless connectivity and control.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern connectivity requirements and feature set.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wireless features function as specified in all supported environments.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security Implementation (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compliance with HP security standards and protects customer data.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All security features pass HP security audit and penetration testing.

requirements.Title: PaaS Model and Solution Integration
requirements.Description: Support PaaS (Printing as a Service) model and integrate with onboarding paths (Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, ECP).
requirements.Rationale: Enables flexible business models and broader market reach.
requirements.Stakeholders: Business Development, Product Management, End Users
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All onboarding and service paths functional and tested with PaaS.

requirements.Title: SMB Manageability and Enterprise Support (WJA, HPSM, JAM)
requirements.Description: Provide SMB manageability solutions and enterprise support for WJA, HPSM, and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Expands market reach and supports business customer requirements.
requirements.Stakeholders: SMB and Enterprise Customers, Product Management, IT
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All specified enterprise solutions function as intended in customer environments.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK Trade Page (Flexible Priority)
requirements.Description: Support hosting a 12,000-page CMYK trade page yield as a flexible feature.
requirements.Rationale: Provides flexibility for higher yield SKUs based on market demand.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU with 12K-CMYK available for markets that require it.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K (Constrained Priority)
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp PHA achieves a minimum life of 65,000 pages as a hard constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Critical component reliability requirement for the platform.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes all reliability tests for 65,000-page life.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years (Optimized Priority)
requirements.Description: Support a warranty life of 2 years for the product, in addition to page life targets.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with competitive and customer expectations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product warranty covers 2 years or 80,000 pages, whichever comes first.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Achieve print throughput of 25/20 pages per minute (PDL: 25/19 ppm).
requirements.Rationale: Meets market expectations for print speed in target segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device achieves specified throughput in ISO standard test conditions.

requirements.Title: Serviceability of Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Ensure the maintenance box is easily serviceable to optimize product uptime.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by service personnel within 10 minutes.
